turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Owen learned about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me. I have until 4:40, so tell me who decided on that mark, and whether anyone heard from Owen first.
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
I didn't agree to anything, Hale; I'd have been in this room whether you asked or not. Was Owen spoken to before that zero went in?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Don't manage me, Hale. I've asked you twice, and I'm writing down that you haven't answered: was Owen heard before that mark was entered?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
Then show me the evidence, Hale, because so far all I've heard is compliments. And I'll ask what you're skipping: did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went into the gradebook?
